notes.title: Update Notes for v0.9.0
notes.content:
Commanders of the Galactic Garrison,
We've heard your feedback and deployed a series of balance adjustments to enhance your defensive strategies against the alien hordes. This update focuses on making your garrison forces more accessible and durable while creating more rewarding engagements with enemy forces.

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Reduced Unit Costs:[/b] All defensive units now require fewer resources to deploy
[*] [b]Enhanced Barricades:[/b] Increased health points for all barricade types
[*] [b]Tougher Frontline:[/b] Increased health for soldiers and turrets
[*] [b]Adjustmented Enemy Forces:[/b] Decreased health points for all enemy types
[*] [b]Reduced Minimum Spawn Counts:[/b] Lowered the minimum number of enemies per wave
[*] [b]Increased Research Rewards:[/b] Higher research point yields from defeated enemies
[/list]
[h3]Technical Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Engine Update:[/b] Updated to the latest version of our game engine
[/list]
We hope these changes will create a more balanced and enjoyable experience for all our defenders. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Small Steps Towards Galactic Domination
notes.content:
We greatly appreciate the community's feedback and efforts in helping shape Galactic Garrison. Here some fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed ui for ultra wide screens
[*] Added space button to start wave
[*] Decrease time between enemy spawning at the beggining of wave
[*] New games now come with a bit more starting cash
[*] Fix hud resource labels
[*] Fix unit ui to show unlocked units properly
[*] Ironed out a few minor wrinkles in the save/load process
[/list]

notes.title: Prepare for the Galactic Garrison Playtest!
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Future Commanders![/b]

The cosmic threats are approaching, and we need your strategic expertise! We're thrilled to announce that the Galactic Garrison playtest will be launching soon. Get ready to defend humanity's last stronghold!

[h2]PLAYTEST DETAILS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Size: ~180 MB
[*] Platform: Windows PC
[/list]

[h2]HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Wishlist Galactic Garrison
[*] Click "Request Access" to gain access.
[*] Come hang out with us on Discord! We'd love to chat about game design, and hear your ideas. We can't wait to meet you! [url=https://discord.gg/YjDKVn2mpN]Join our Discord![/url]
[/olist]

[h2]WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE PLAYTEST[/h2]
[list]
[*] Turn-based strategic defense gameplay
[*] Free-form unit placement system
[*]Three unit types: Barricades, Soldiers, Turrets
[*] Special ability cards
[/list]

[h2]COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT[/h2]
We believe in developing games alongside our community.
Your feedback during the playtest will directly influence the final version of Galactic Garrison. We'll be actively engaging with playtesters through Discord and Steam Discussions with regular feedbacks.

The galaxy needs commanders like you!
Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the playtest launch date.

Best regards,
The Feature Creep Team
